exams.subject_km: វិញ្ញាសាទី២១

sections.title_km: គណនាលីមីតខាងក្រោម

questions.label: a
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=1. Factor the numerator by grouping: x^3-x^2+x-1 = x^2(x-1)+(x-1) = (x-1)(x^2+1). Cancel (x-1), then substitute x=1 into x^2+1.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=pi/2. Use sin^2x-1=-cos^2x=-(1-sin x)(1+sin x), cancel the (1+sin x) factor with the denominator, leaving -(1-sin x); substitute sin(pi/2)=1.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: ∞-∞ at infinity. Multiply and divide by the conjugate sqrt(x^2+x)+x to turn the difference into x/(sqrt(x^2+x)+x), then divide numerator and denominator by x and let x→∞.

questions.label: d
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Split as (e^{-x}+e^x) · (sin x / x)^2 / 2. The exponential factor is continuous (→2 at x=0) and the sinc-squared factor uses the standard limit sin x/x → 1.

questions.label: e
questions.technique: ∞-∞ (log difference) at infinity. Combine logs: ln(x+2)-ln x = ln(1+2/x) → 0 as x→∞ (standard log limit form), and 2/(x+2) → 0, leaving only the constant 1/4.
